focus: This week I'm wrapping up BudgetTracker's Postgres migration and hardening the AI assistant with per-provider key isolation, while also advancing the MCP server that exposes read-only financial tools behind scoped tokens to my local AI agent. On the side, the Cadence speed-reader MVP is feature-complete and now in polish phase — refining Haiku-based adaptive pacing across both TUI and web GUI frontends.
